title: Page 3
content_zh:
也不是他有什么特异之处，只是看着石草，龙焱就会想起自己当年被老当家袁师傅带进“一条龙”的往事，当时他跟石草颇像，也是个头矮小，一副怯怯模样。
龙焱突然说：“昨天常见你进灶房问事。”
他发现了？!她蓦地抬头，眼儿头回与他对上。
“怎么突然又不进去了？”
枣儿没料堂堂当家竟会关心这种事，怔愕了一会儿，才挤出方才答过余盛的话。“我爹说灶房忙，要我没事别进去叨扰……”
“你对割烹有兴趣？”
这问题，教枣儿腼地笑了。
“想不想学？”
“我？”她又吓了一跳，指着自个儿鼻头。
废话。龙焱一瞪。
本着袁师傅当年交代，“一条龙”传贤不传子，他刚才瞧过石草表现，确定是个可造之材，所以才动了念想收石草进灶房见习。
天呐，枣儿兴奋地胀红了脸。能跟龙焱学割烹，只能说是天上掉下来的好运道——只差那么一点她就答应了，要不是同时想起她爹的交代，龙爷不喜欢女人进灶房，要万一被他知道她是女娃，事情会很严重吧！枣儿冒了满头汗。
龙焱淡声问：“不愿意？”
“不是。”枣儿哪敢告诉他实情，忙找了个借口搪塞。“我是想到，我是来替我爹的工，那如果我开始学割烹，不就变成我爹没了工作……”
“你以为你一点头，就能马上掌锅拿杓？”龙焱难得笑了。
枣儿瞧得心头扑通扑通，龙焱本来就俊，再一笑，更是教她脸颊不住烧红。
“回去跟你爹商量，如果要，明儿空暇时间就过来跟余盛学削皮，平常工作一样得做，到你爹回来为止。”
也不等她回话，龙焱说完就走了，枣儿紧抓着刀柄，表情烦恼极了。
该做还是拒绝？两个声音在她脑中交战，一个要她把握机会，先做先赢；一个是责备她自私，假扮成男孩蒙混已是不对，这会儿她还想假装到底，学人家精湛厨艺……
怎么办？她捧着发烫的脸颊苦恼。若回家问爹，爹定会叫她拒绝，可是——她好想学！

“嗳……”枣儿再叹。
主意还拿不定，可时间依然故我飞快溜走。工作时间结束，天色一黑，门厅里再度涌进喝酒吃宴的客人。枣儿又开始忙着洗碗擦碗，还要偷空帮堂倌伙计排桌摆椅。忙了半个多时辰，枣儿突然听见前廊有人在唤她名。
“石草？你在不在？”
“我在这儿。”枣儿抹净手从几大迭碗盘后站了起来。
是先前和枣儿换工的老崔与老夏。老崔看着她说：“龙爷要用一组蟠桃绘的钵盘，快跟我们去取。”
枣儿这才知道，原来她刚在擦洗的碗盘，只是供给一般客人使用；如果达官贵人上门，就得另取杯盘。
“藤萝树后边就是龙爷住的地方。”
老崔两人领着枣儿进了龙焱私人跨院，一路悬着灯笼的院落同样大得吓人，光建在池塘中的水心亭，枣儿估忖，就应该比他们家那个小矮房还宽了。
老崔又说：“没事别靠近，听清楚了？”
枣儿憨憨地点头，整个心神全被头上的花树吸引。在灯笼余光下犹可看见浓艳的紫色，香气四散。
老崔转头发觉枣儿没跟上，扬声喝：“还杵在那儿做什么？还不快点！”
枣儿这才回过神来，赶忙跟上。
“我是不晓得你会担这工担多久，”老崔边说边掏钥匙价值连城，拿捧收拾都要特别留心。”
“没错。”一旁的老夏跟着恐吓。“万一摔着了，卖了你也还赔不起！”
枣儿戒慎惶恐地跟着走入长屋，她吞了吞唾沫，难掩惊异地瞪着眼前摆设。先说这屋，一幢就比她家还大上十多倍，屋里全部摆满木架，架前分别挂着木牌标示“梅”、“兰”、“竹”、“菊”、“牡丹”、“蟠桃”等等。老夏走到“蟠桃”架前抱了一迭盘，眼一溜要枣儿过来。
“小心点捧，当心脚步。”
枣儿像极了初进城的乡巴佬，紧张兮兮地点着头。
她低头看，粉白的盘上绘着一圈艳红蟠桃，再瞧瞧邻旁，还有铭黄框边盘心涂绘着牡丹的典雅盘器，瞧瞧上头每枝花每颗桃都栩栩如生，难怪刚才老崔会说这些对象都价格不菲。
“还磨蹭什么？龙爷急着用呢！”老崔提醒。
噢对。枣儿步伐小心但快速地将蟠桃盘抱进灶房，人人喊他“王二”的二厨丢了块布，要她把盘子再拭净，就在这时，枣儿瞧见立在灶房门口的龙焱，正在四厨子的帮忙下解去上衣。

【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】
“松鼠鱼上桌。”四厨端起喊道。
“松鼠鱼上桌。”堂倌在外头接手。
就这么眨眼，龙焱已又换上新锅，这会儿正在红烧大乌参，接着是烩三丁、油爆河虾。
灶房热气一烘，没一会儿龙焱全身汗湿，宽阔的胸膛背脊布满豆大汗滴。枣儿发傻地望着那肌理结实的身躯，头次感觉到男人与女人的差异。
瞧那身肌肉，紧绷紧绷，枣儿忍不住摸摸脸颊，揣测它可能会有的触感。好想伸手碰碰看呐——脑子一转过这念头，她身子突然一阵麻。
“事情做完了就出去。”三厨顶了枣儿一肘，不喜她杵在灶边发愣，里边人忙得都快翻了，闲杂人等还不知速速退场！
“是是……”枣儿缩着脖子回道。
就在这时，账房叫人来喊龙爷，说小院里的贵客要请他见面。
龙焱抛下长柄杓，转头，见枣儿正要离开，他冲着她喊：“拧条湿布给我。”
枣儿没敢怠慢，一出长屋，就见门边放了水桶跟布巾，她忙拧干将湿布送上。
龙焱也没避讳，接过巾帕便头儿颈儿臂膀抹去汗滴，一方白帕有如蝴蝶忽左忽右，同时也撩动了枣儿一颗少女心。
多想、多想伸手向前摸个一把！
龙焱浑然不觉自己动作多么诱人，他抹完身子，唰地将帕子丢进枣儿手里。她手发抖地捧着余温犹存的白帕，突然有股冲动，想要把这块沾满汗水的布块，偷回家妥善保存。
“衣服。”
四厨拎着衣裳挤开枣儿，不意撞掉了她想妥善。
就这么眨眼，龙焱已着好装。
“洗好碗了？”他看着仍低头不动的枣儿，顶了她一把。
这一声问打散枣儿脑中绮想，她吓着似地双眼一瞠。
“还、还没……”

四厨在一旁骂：“没还不快去！”
挨骂的枣儿急忙跑开，可没一会儿，穿好衣裳的龙焱快步赶过她。擦身而过时她偷瞄了一眼，惊讶地发现，才这么会儿时间，他已经从刚才的忙乱热，变回先前滴汗不出、云淡风轻神态。
好个当家掌杓的风范！
望着龙焱越走越远的背影，枣儿突然觉得心窝一阵乱，好像原本平静的什么，瞬间翻腾起来了。
第2章(1)
又是一个透早，枣儿脚边摆着箕箩，人又开始对着翠绿的黄瓜说话：“你说我是怎么了，明明累得倦得不得了，为什么眼儿一闭上，整个脑袋都是龙爷身影？”
【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】
“我真不知道自己该怎么办了，我真的想跟龙爷学割烹，可又不想违背爹的交代——”她对着摘下的黄瓜叹了口气，才这么一会儿，思绪又往别边飘去。
content_en:
It's not that there is anything special about him, just looking at Shi Cao, Long Yan will remember the past when he was brought into "Yilong" by his old boss Master Yuan. At that time, he was quite similar to Shi Cao, he was also short and timid.
Long Yan suddenly said: "I saw you coming into the kitchen yesterday to ask questions."
Did he find out? !She suddenly raised her head and met his eyes.
"Why didn't you go in all of a sudden?"
Zao'er didn't expect that the head of the family would care about such a thing. She was stunned for a while before she managed to squeeze out the words she had just said to Yu Sheng. "My dad said the kitchen was busy and asked me not to go in and bother me when I'm fine..."
"Are you interested in Kappo?"
This question made Zaoer smile shyly.
"Do you want to learn?"
"Me?" She was startled again and pointed at her nose.
nonsense. Long Yan stared.
In line with Master Yuan's instructions at the time, "one line" passes down talents rather than sons. He had just seen Shicao's performance and was sure that he was a promising talent, so he had the idea to take Shicao into the kitchen as a trainee.
Oh my god, Zaoer's face turned red with excitement. Being able to learn cutting and cooking from Long Yan can only be said to be a blessing from the sky - she agreed just a little bit. If she hadn't remembered her father's instructions at the same time, Master Long didn't like women to enter the kitchen. If he found out that she was a girl, things would have been serious! Zaoer was sweating.
Long Yan asked quietly: "Don't want to?"
"No." Zao'er didn't dare to tell him the truth, so she hurriedly found an excuse. "I thought, I am here to work for my father, so if I start learning Kappo, my father will lose his job..."
"Do you think you can take the pot and the ladle right away with just a nod?" Long Yan rarely smiled.
Zao'er's heart skipped a beat when she saw it. Long Yan was already handsome, but when he smiled again, her cheeks couldn't help but burn red.
"Go back and discuss it with your father. If you want, come over tomorrow in your free time and learn to peel it from Yu Sheng. You have to do your usual work until your father comes back."
Without waiting for her reply, Long Yan left after speaking. Zao'er clutched the handle of the knife tightly with a very troubled expression.
Should you do it or say no? Two voices were fighting in her mind. One wanted her to seize the opportunity and win first. The other accused her of being selfish. It was no longer right to pretend to be a boy to fool around. At this moment, she still wanted to pretend to the end and learn from others' superb cooking skills...
What to do? She held her hot cheeks in distress. If she went home and asked her father, he would tell her to refuse, but - she really wanted to learn!
"Hey..." Zao'er sighed again.
I am still undecided, but time is still flying by as usual. When the working hours were over and it got dark, the foyer once again flooded with guests drinking and feasting. Zao'er was busy washing and wiping dishes again, and also took some time to help the waiters and waiters arrange tables and chairs. After being busy for more than half an hour, Zaoer suddenly heard someone calling her name on the front porch.
"Shicao? Are you here?"
"I'm here." Zao'er wiped her hands and stood up from behind several stacks of dishes.
It was Lao Cui and Lao Xia who had previously exchanged jobs with Zaoer. Lao Cui looked at her and said, "Master Long wants to use a set of peach-painted alms bowls. Come with us to get them."
Only then did Zaoer realize that the dishes she had just been cleaning were only for ordinary guests; if a dignitary came to visit, they would have to get another cup and plate.
"Behind the wisteria tree is where Mr. Long lives."
Lao Cui and the other two led Zao'er into Long Yan's private courtyard. The courtyard with lanterns hanging all the way was equally scary. The Shuixin Pavilion built in the pond alone, Zao'er estimated, should be wider than their small house.
Lao Cui said again: "Don't come close if you have nothing to do. Do you hear me clearly?"
Zao'er nodded naively, her whole mind attracted by the flowers and trees above her head. In the residual light of the lantern, you can still see the rich purple color, and the fragrance spreads everywhere.
Lao Cui turned around and realized that Zao'er hadn't followed him, so he shouted loudly: "What are you still doing there? Hurry up!"
Only then did Zaoer come back to his senses and hurried to follow.
"I don't know how long you will be doing this job," Lao Cui said as he took out the keys, which are extremely valuable, so be careful when handling them. ""That's right." Lao Xia threatened. "If it falls, you won't be able to afford the compensation if I sell it!"
Zaoer Jieshen followed into the longhouse in fear. She swallowed her saliva and stared at the decorations in front of her in surprise. Let’s talk about this house first. It is more than ten times bigger than her home. The house is full of wooden shelves. In front of the shelves are wooden signs hanging, which are marked with "Plum", "Orchid", "Bamboo", "Chrysanthemum", "Peony", "Peach" and so on. Lao Xia walked to the "Peach" shelf and hugged a stack of plates, and immediately asked Zao'er to come over.
"Be careful with your holdings and watch your steps."
Zao'er looked like a country bumpkin who had just entered the city, nodding nervously.
She looked down and saw a circle of bright red peaches painted on the pink and white plate. Then she looked at the elegant plate next to it, with a yellow frame and painted peonies on the center of the plate. Every flower and peach on it was lifelike. No wonder Lao Cui just said that these objects are expensive.
"Why are you still dawdling? Master Long is in a hurry to use it!" Lao Cui reminded.
Oh yes. Zao'er carefully but quickly carried the peach plate into the kitchen. The second chef, who everyone called him "Wang Er," threw a piece of cloth and asked her to wipe the plate clean again. At this moment, Zao'er saw Long Yan standing at the door of the kitchen, taking off his shirt with the help of the fourth chef.
[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]
"Squirrel fish is on the table." The fourth chef picked up the fish and shouted.
"The squirrel fish is served." The waiter took over from outside.
Just in the blink of an eye, Long Yan had put on a new pot and was now braised black ginseng, followed by braised diced tripe and fried river prawns.
The kitchen was filled with heat, and soon Long Yan's whole body was soaked with sweat, and his broad chest and back were covered with sweat drops. Zaoer looked at the strong body in a daze, feeling the difference between men and women for the first time.
Looking at those muscles, they were so tight that Zaoer couldn't help but touch her cheek, trying to guess how it might feel. She really wanted to reach out and touch it - as soon as this thought came to her mind, her body suddenly felt numb.
"Go out as soon as you're done." The third chef elbowed Zao'er, not liking that she was standing by the stove in a daze. The people inside were so busy that they almost turned over, and the rest of the crowd didn't know how to leave quickly!
"Yes..." Zao'er replied, shrinking her neck.
At this moment, the accountant called someone to call Mr. Long, saying that the distinguished guest in the small courtyard wanted to invite him to meet.
Long Yan threw down the long-handled ladle and turned around. Seeing Zao'er about to leave, he shouted to her: "Twist me a wet cloth."
Zaoer didn't dare to neglect. As soon as she came out of the longhouse, she saw a bucket and cloth towels placed by the door. She hurriedly wrung out the wet cloths and brought them over.
Long Yan didn't shy away from it. He took the kerchief and wiped the sweat off his neck and arms. The white kerchief fluttered left and right like a butterfly, and at the same time it stirred Zao'er's girlish heart.
I want to reach out and touch it!
Long Yan didn't realize how seductive his movements were. After wiping his body, he threw the handkerchief into Zao'er's hand. She held the white handkerchief that was still warm with trembling hands, and she suddenly felt the urge to steal the sweat-stained piece of cloth home for safekeeping.
"Clothes."
Si Chu was carrying her clothes and squeezing Zao'er away, but accidentally knocked her away and tried to take care of herself.
In just a blink of an eye, Long Yan was already dressed.
"Have you washed the dishes?" He looked at Zao'er who still lowered her head and gave her a push.
This question dispersed Zaoer's thoughts, and she opened her eyes in fear.
"Not yet..."
The fourth chef scolded from the side: "If you don't, hurry up and go!"
Zao'er, who was scolded, ran away in a hurry, but after a while, Long Yan, who was fully clothed, quickly passed her. She took a sneak peek as he passed by and was surprised to find that in just a short time, he had changed from being busy and hot to his previous demeanor of being calm and calm without breaking a sweat.
What a master of the house!
Looking at Long Yan's back walking further and further away, Zao'er suddenly felt a turmoil in her heart, as if something that had been calm suddenly started to stir.
Chapter 2(1)
It was another early morning, and there was a basket at Zaoer's feet, and the person began to talk to the green cucumber again: "What do you think is wrong with me? MingMing is extremely tired, why does the image of Mr. Long appear all over his head when he closes his eyes? "
[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]
"I really don't know what to do. I really want to learn Kappo from Mr. Long, but I don't want to go against my father's instructions -" She sighed at the cucumbers she picked, and after a while, her thoughts drifted elsewhere.
